Per-rule overrides of the base catalogue of the query page: label, note and the numeric defaults (val, lo, hi, step, on). Keys are rule ids; a note may use tokens.

Rules added by the profile on top of the base catalogue. Fields: id, group, label, metric (key of design.m, or the expression unsat_density), op, val, lo, hi, step, dec, unit, on, note, rescue [title, text].

Query rules built from the specificity panel. expr says what the rule measures: species (identity fraction in one species of the panel), min_species, paralog (share of the epitope identical in one paralog), paralog_max_excl (the highest over all paralogs but one). nl: keywords and compiled text for the natural-language box.
Example queries under the natural-language box: [{label, q}].

Words the natural-language box recognises beyond its built-in ones. epitope: extra words for "on the intended epitope"; off_epitope_exclude: words that cancel the off-epitope reading; glycan_named: word -> label of a named glycan site; partner and flag_region are handled by rules.extra[].nl.

keys.description: Browser tab titles by page.
The small badge in the header: class (mock = dashed grey, real = green, run = green) and text. Tooltips are text.badge.title.<page>.
Credit line at the foot of every page (HTML) and its plain-text twin for exports. null = no credit line.
Identity of the target. label is the string written into exported recipes; span_label is the construct subtitle of the inspector; construct.label describes the construct in breadcrumbs.

Target frame strip of the inspector: where the construct sits in the full-length protein. segments: [{label, start, end, kind, phrase?}] with kind x (outside or unstructured), v, c, l (linker), b, s, h; phrase names the segment inside a sentence (finding.epi.bad.title). glycan_sites: N-glycosylation sites of the full protein (UniProt). native_range: extent of the mature chain, used to decide which ends of the construct are cuts.

Presentation of the membrane exclusion plane. plane_radius: radius of the 3D disc of the inspector; plane_half_size: half side of the plane drawn on the query page; strip_shade: ranges of target residues shaded as membrane-side on the map strip (null: derive from the plane, residues whose CA lies within 12 A of it).

Camera and marker settings. query_fit_pad: share of the query viewer the target fills; inspector_focus: all (zoom to everything) or binder; inspector_zoom: zoom factor after the initial fit; map_size_metric: metric that sizes the map markers (ipsae or iptm).

Specificity panel. species: [{match, label, key, phrase?, table?, card?, optional?}]; match is an organism name or acc:<accession> (the entry of HOM.orth); phrase is the in-sentence name; table and card are the short column heads on the map table and hover card. show: keys of the map specificity block; headline: species of the headline finding; detail: entries whose differences the detail sentence names (a key, or {group, keys}); paralogs.focus: the paralog that gets its own bar and rule.

Names of the models. primary: the model that made the complex; rescore: independent co-folding re-scores; monomer: the binder-alone model; design_model_prefix: prefix of the pose entry that is the design model itself; colors: overlay colour per pose entry name.
Capability flags. Every flag is written explicitly by the exporter; an absent flag means false. See profile_spec.md for what each one gates and which REAL branch it replaces.
Interpretation settings of the checks and findings. See profile_spec.md section 5 for the full list and the REAL branches they replace.
Mode notes the data does not carry. mode id -> note.
Reason chips of the decision panel, keys 1 to 7: [[key, label], ...]. The key is stored in review events.
Region of the target whose contacts are counted separately (m.stalk_n, octx.stalk): key, label, range. null = none.
"What to try" tips of the board page (HTML strings).
"What to try" tips of the map page (HTML strings).
"What to try" tips of the inspector page (HTML strings).
"What to try" tips of the query page (HTML strings).

Import modal of the board. files: legacy file tree [[name, description, state]] (state ok, mu or miss) shown when the bundle has no manifest; files_extra: rows after the tree; cards: [{column, title, html, chips?, actions?, tag?}]. Descriptions may use tokens.
